name_en: Sponsorship for children in need (Integrated Child Protection Scheme / Mission Vatsalya)
department: Department of Social Defence (District Child Protection Unit), Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Money support for a child in need, so the child can stay with family and keep studying. The district page says Rs 2,000 a month for each child, for up to 2 children in a family, for up to 3 years or until age 18.

other: Family income below Rs 24,000 a year in villages, Rs 30,000 in cities, Rs 36,000 in metro cities.
The child does not get money help from another government scheme.
First choice goes to children of a single mother or widow, children of parents with leprosy or HIV, and children whose parent is in jail.
Also for children in a children's home for over 6 months who can go back to their family.

documents: Petition with one passport size photo
Bonafide certificate from the head master
Aadhaar copy of child and parents
how_to_apply: Give a petition with the papers to the District Child Protection Unit. A village level child protection committee also finds children who need help.
where_to_apply: District Child Protection Unit (Department of Social Defence) in your district.

evidence.quote: District Child Protection Unit, (Integrated Child Protection Scheme), Department of Social Defence.
Sponsorship is the provision of supplementary support to families to meet medical, nutritional, educational and other needs of their children
Rs.2000 per child per month for maximum 2 children per family.
Duration-Maximum three years or up to 18 years, whichever is earlier
Children, of the age of 0 to18 years.
Children of families are having Annual income below Rs.24,000/- in villages, Rs.30,000/- in Cities Rs.36,000/- in Metro Cities.
Children who are not availing any Financial Assistance from other Schemes of State / Central Government.
Children of a single mother / widow
Children of Leprosy patients / HIV infected parent
Children whose parent / bread earner is in jail.
Children staying in child care institutions for more than six months continuously, who can be restored to their families.

Income Certificate

Sponsorship is provided for the children in need of Care and Protection.
Social Defence Department under Integrated Child Protection Scheme has been functioning in 38 district of Tamilnadu from August 2012 at District Child Protection Unit.
